purpose: Every speed, memory and startup enhancement that a SparkRing deployment can enable, listed once with the models and TP/DCP sizes it applies to, the exact settings that enable it, the images that carry it, its status and its measured gain with conditions and evidence. scripts/check_enhancements.py checks a deployment against it; scripts/generate_enhancements.py renders performance/enhancements.md from it. Profiles own the settings they run; this catalog does not configure anything.

categories.kernel-backend: Kernel or backend setting: B12X or vLLM kernel choice, quantized-weight path, or the image whose sources a deployment runs
categories.speculative-decoding: Speculative-decoding setting: drafter, draft depth, draft sampling and verification, draft quantization
categories.checkpoint: Checkpoint selection: a pinned repository revision, chosen with a profile's checkpoint table or another profile
categories.transport: Collective transport setting: SIRCL ring sessions, NCCL or the prepared RoCEnante transport
categories.vllm-plugin: vLLM general plugin, image feature hook or cache connector
categories.scheduler-compile: vLLM engine setting: scheduling, parallel layout, sequence count, CUDA graphs and compilation
categories.host-setting: Setting of the Spark host outside the container

sides.decode: decode speed: steps per second or output tokens per second
sides.prefill: prefill speed: prompt tokens per second or time to first token
sides.memory: memory or capacity: weight or KV memory per rank, KV tokens, concurrent sequences
sides.startup: time to a ready API, or whether the model starts at all

statuses.implemented: built and exercised by a profile or image; not serving-qualified
statuses.qualified: passed the stated qualification under the stated conditions
statuses.research-only: runs, but its evidence is light, partial or private
